reference: Only exact single-line scalar candidates in the caller resource or its resolved external scope are offered. Unsafe required input, duplicate resources, dynamic values, block scalars, sibling resources and other namespaces must not leak candidates. A provably local safe correction may proceed while another file is incomplete; scope-dependent edits require a complete scope. Exact quoted replacement preserves comments, Unicode and CRLF, and removes the selected diagnostic.
enum: artifactGC.strategy at 3.6.0 allows exactly empty string, Never, OnWorkflowCompletion, OnWorkflowDeletion. Invalid single-line exact literal gets four explicit choices; valid, block scalar and foreign GVK get none.
pin: Opened scope inheriting an exact supported version offers inserting exactly targetVersion at that scope. Opened root with an explicit exact LSP override offers root persistence. Existing equal pin and closed config offer none. Default or explicit auto, including editor overrides and inherited scopes, offers no pin action and does not change any workspace file. No diagnostic is invented for legal inheritance. Scope/resource target and unrelated bytes stay unchanged.
identity: Actions resolve into versioned documentChanges only. Changing the selected document or an actual action dependency rejects with -32801; an unrelated peer preserves a local edit. Disk input remains unchanged. Tests use real stdio LSP and record frames and exit code.
ablation: The strict legacy registry builds a passing baseline and each changed binary, then requires complete results and named failures. Compile errors, crashes, missing output and timeouts never count as detection. The single-literal mutation is detected by a block-scalar local reference; the enum case independently checks schema-query refusal.
pinPersistence: After applying each pin, a fresh CLI with no LSP override must read the intended exact version and one resource. Explicit YAML document terminators, CRLF and trailing comments must remain intact; insertion stays before the end marker.
